# Dump values

`tinkerpad-dump-v1`. A playground writes one of these inside an escape
sequence and TinkerPad takes it out of the output and renders it. The
sequence and the rules are in [PLUGINS.md](../PLUGINS.md) §6; these are
the payloads, written by the same types the output pane reads.

```json
{
  "v": 1,
  "title": "answer",
  "kind": "value",
  "value": 42,
  "type": "int"
}
```

```json
{
  "v": 1,
  "title": "people",
  "kind": "table",
  "columns": [
    {
      "name": "name"
    },
    {
      "name": "n"
    }
  ],
  "rows": [
    [
      "ada",
      1
    ],
    [
      "grace",
      2
    ]
  ],
  "truncated": false
}
```

```json
{
  "v": 1,
  "kind": "tree",
  "value": {
    "a": [
      1,
      2
    ]
  },
  "type": "dict"
}
```
